editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a dark house while a killer is hunting you, but you cannot even see where they are. That is the scary spot Emily finds herself in. After a bad car crash took her mom, Emily stopped being able to see, even though her eyes are fine. It is all in her head from the trauma. Now, on a night when kids are playing pranks, a real monster enters her home. You get to feel her fear as she uses her hearing and touch to stay alive. It is a tense ride that makes you realize how scary it is to lose your most important sense when you are in danger.

The acting is solid and makes you really root for Emily to make it out. The pacing is quick, though some parts feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of thrillers. Still, the way it uses sound to build tension is a big win. If you love home invasion stories, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the end, Emily has to fight the intruder using everything she has. The stress of the attack actually triggers something in her mind. In a huge moment of survival, she finally regains her sight just in time to see the killer and fight back. She manages to defeat the intruder and save her family. The movie wraps up with her healing from her trauma, showing that her will to live was stronger than her fear.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and home invasion movies.
